# Silicon Mango Academy

> Live instructor-led cohorts, self-paced tracks, and expert webinars in Excel, Python, SQL, and AI for working professionals across India. Verifiable certificates on completion.

## Programs & Courses
- [All Courses](https://academy.siliconmango.in/courses): Browse live cohorts and self-paced programs in Excel, Python, SQL, and AI.
- [Live Batches](https://academy.siliconmango.in/courses?type=live): Cohort-based live online classes with mentor doubt-clearing and capstone projects.
- [Self-Paced Courses](https://academy.siliconmango.in/courses?type=self_paced): Learn on your schedule with mobile-optimized video lessons.

## Live Masterclasses
